title: Pick, install and set the theme
description:
## Objective
A non-default theme installed and set, plus a slide transition. No slide content changes.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-theme/2026-08-13-theme-spec.md`

## Scope
**Files:** `slides/package.json` (theme dep), `slides/slides.md` (headmatter only)

## Implementation
1. Verify the theme against the deck before committing: installs, renders all three diagrams, needs no slide rewrites, readable at size.
2. @slidev/theme-seriph is the recommended default. Record the reason if you pick another.
3. Set theme: and transition: in headmatter. Change nothing else in slides.md.
4. Look at slides 4, 17 and 19 rendered. If the theme clips them, pick a different theme — do not edit the slides.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build && npm run slides && npm run diagrams`. All three must pass.
acceptance_criteria: theme is not 'default'; build, count and diagrams all green; slides 4, 17, 19 not clipped
closed_reason: seriph installed and set; slide-left transition; slides 4/17/19 measured as fitting; all three checks green
